# Independent History admission contract correction review r2

Status: **Affected Green for the finite semantic amendment. HAD-01, HAD-02 and
HAD-03 are closed at contract level. One nonblocking P3 reference correction
below remains Root-owned before adoption.**

Reviewer: `admission_contract_review`; configured `gpt-6-astra/max` from
`.codex/config.toml`. No explicit model/effort denial or fallback was reported.
All commands started at P=`/home/kubotak/projects/blackops`.
C=`.phpunit.cache/f2-orchestration/accepted-integration`;
A=`.phpunit.cache/f5-orchestration/20261015/admission-contract-candidate`;
E14/E15 are the dated `.phpunit.cache/f5-orchestration/20261014` and
`20261015` evidence directories. Product paths are relative to C; candidate
paths are relative to A. This reviewer did not execute Git. Root's pinned resume
receipt identifies C's integration branch at82bb574; no commit/remote result is
claimed independently here.

## Summary and exact reviewed inputs

The nine-file management candidate closes the three finite corrections from
E14/history-admission-design-review-r1.md. It preserves the accepted separation
between pure local admission and actual-record/Grammar/replay authority.
The previously reviewed seven-helper design and unrelated F5 contracts were
not reopened. No Product input, test, runtime lease, DB, authority document,
Task/Report/STATE or Git state was changed by this reviewer.

The reviewed amendment is
`develop/orchestration/contracts/P23-003F5P/history-admission-responsibility-amendment-r1.md`,
SHA256 `336ad3d1bc96dfb96c0bbd801fb7f5adc5482b8ef8ce15bdc176f7ea8d8ef322`
(25,666 bytes). The candidate README/allowlist/manifest hashes are respectively
`d266c9df3e40e966d8d7cf98024a320436577183cf3a941d277e7943b292a695`,
`1582ca472ca867eef08c168e692ee05cf54bd0845fce0bbd06a498d9e8164283`,
`0dd02575bf9553c40111ff1ae2bddd67524166489a69266b807a37cfbd23f071`.
Candidate spec130 is
`f45d3662fba4df5e221ca5c091a7d3a271f12a36634efe289d8092d4798d43a5`;
candidate D179 is
`0c781fc95394181a029493702ceeddbb6f52c76436623b4f905d1225b909a507`.

The retained proposal861134dd5b44e3563ac96483e78ffeaed930b8e893c76235045ec0ade4ff754a,
review368a6286451f5264ab186a9c7fdadfd7125c1de83066795fe0506a16647a417e
and review-input5e6a28de76860255066d23b1d8fa201297f2ff29cd83620efc681af66dbce4ea
are historical evidence. The candidate explicitly makes the finite amendment,
README precedence and Root's eventual committed issuance authoritative; those
preserved documents do not independently authorize implementation.

## Finding closure

### HAD-01 — closed: actual and captured version domains remain distinct

Amendment §1:40,61 and159 fixes actual Segment12 open1..MAX, actual
Segment12/Proof14 closed/sealed2..MAX, and tag31 captured
closed_state_version2..MAX−1. It retains the two existing version-operation
callers, without a tag/phase argument, helper, F2 call or invented captured value.
Spec125:122–135's reserved seal increment is explicitly scoped to captured
preparation. Actual closedMAX remains locally admissible even though a new
preparation cannot use it; sealed2 is not elevated into an authenticated F2 retry.

This agrees with the unchanged History map:94–135 and the accepted owners:
PostgreSqlAuditCheckpointPreparationWorkflow::create rejects closedMAX for new
preparation, while PostgreSqlAuditCheckpointStoredBinding::stateVersion requires
captured2..MAX−1 and actual=captured for closed / captured+1 for sealed.
The unchanged r1 evidence for the native row parser, close increment, closed
graph/neighbors and the sealed(MAX−1,MAX) test remains valid: all41 r1 semantic
input pins match. The focused current reads confirm the distinction; no F2 test
was executed again.

The candidate requires actual closedMAX/sealedMAX positives, actual
closed/sealed1 and MAX+1 negatives, captured2/MAX−1 positives and1/MAX negatives,
and retains the separate exact F2 sealed(MAX−1,MAX) positive. No global cap or
accepted F2 behavior is changed.

### HAD-02 — closed: endpoint and Presence recovery matrices are complete

Amendment §1:63,66–95 and §4:159 matches r1's full table after strict scalar and
null-pair admission:

| Reservation | Ordinal | Preparation | Candidate | Complete |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| absent | 0 | absent | absent | absent |
| present | 0 | absent or present | absent | absent |
| present | 1 | present | absent | absent |
| present | 2 | present | present | absent or present |
| present | 3/4 | present | present | present |

All other combinations are rejected. The five named null pairs,
last_ordinal0 iff null last_step_digest, and higher_work_ordinal_present=false
remain. The exact tag25 projection omits the candidate field and otherwise
keeps the same reservation/count/preparation/complete matrix.

Both required recovery gaps survive: actual F2 preparation committed before
ordinal1, and actual F2 complete persistence committed before ordinal3.
Candidate bytes remain tied to ordinal2 itself, so candidate presence is exactly
ordinal>=2. The unchanged History map:231–243 and Composition:224–234 support
those separate roots and actual tag30/31/32/33/34 observations.

The amendment explicitly preserves Grammar's observed sequence/count, actual
row identity, byte/digest/length agreement and replay's authenticated
predecessors, F1/F2 equality, current scope/source/phase preconditions.
Historical ordinal4 is readable without adding its producer. The required
factory and actual Codec positives and isolated negatives are explicit;
none was executed and none substitutes for later actual-record/replay proof.

### HAD-03 — closed: the actual existing timestamp guard is assigned

Amendment §3:149–155 now names all six affected verification paths.
The added existing owner is `tests/Architecture/AuditRecordArchitectureTest.php`,
with the exact timestamp tuple
`Internal/Audit/Authority/History/AuditHistoryScalar.php => admitString:1`.
Its literal A2 row permits AuditRecordTime at that path; a planned NativeGroup
row is removed, not retained alongside it. Unrelated tuples stay unchanged.

This directly matches the inspected source-wide inventory comparison at
AuditRecordArchitectureTest:1387–1431 and its literal A2 reference collectors at
4517–4625. The existing test is in both editPaths and existingPhpTestEdits.
Alias/FQCN positives and relocated-method, duplicate-call, sibling-helper and
extra-A2-type negatives are assigned. The separate AuthorityHistory guard
retains the one Core-validation site and all helper edges. No namespace
allowance or F1/F2/public API exception follows.

## Finite integration, preservation and quality boundary

- README correction12 is a finite overlay, conditional on affected Green,
  Root adoption and committed Task issuance. Earlier chronology and immutable
  statuses remain historical. The two historical25-type descriptions still
  identify the original closure; correction12 states effective27→34.
  D179 preserves its prior complete text and appends only this refinement.
- The candidate manifest preserves all50 existing immutable entries and adds
  only the proposal, r1 review, its inputs and the amendment. The semantic delta
  and byte identities were inspected. Root's completed mechanical receipt
  E15/admission-candidate-mechanical-check.json is reused for all50 retained
  identities, including the original47 decoded records, and exact seven-path
  allowance. This same-input successful bookkeeping check was not rerun.
  This review independently pins every retained file before/after; no huge
  source/vendor tree scan or unchanged full F5 review was performed.
- The exact seven new paths and27 declarations remain the r1-approved inventory:
  Scalar5, Context6, Lifecycle2, Closed4, Work4, End2, Publication4.
  Private constructors have zero Product instantiation sites. The fixed
  NativeGroup constructor routes cover5+4+3+3+1+4+11=31 distinct admitted tags;
  the other19 remain rejected. Only Lifecycle.assertValid→Closed.version is an
  external helper-to-helper edge. NativeGroup9/max2 and Record10/max3 remain.
- NativeGroup retains the one literal schema, exact key/reference admission,
  actual strictly admitted primitive returns, relations before retention,
  SensitiveParameter arguments and its fresh cause-free error boundary.
  Codec retains exactly two public methods, removes the duplicate schema and
  only its encode→Group.tag edge. Its original boundary/CR/LF/cap checks,
  null-safe string stripping and anchored flat-container check remain before
  recursive JCS. No raw input or prior Throwable is licensed to escape.
  These are retained design conclusions, not newly executed PHP results.
- Allowlist297→304 adds only the seven exact Product paths. Reference62,
 35 new/26 existing PHP tests and58 native runs stay fixed. The six affected
  verification paths are the GroupCodec unit, AuthorityHistory architecture,
  existing AuditRecord architecture, AuthorityFilesystemCase, package-export
  and required-inventory scripts. Direct JSON membership inspection confirms
  all six are already in the candidate allowance; the two new PHPUnit classes
  and the existing timestamp class retain their original inventory ownership.
- Spec130's delta inserts exactly the seven literal FQCNs immediately after
  NativeGroup, changing additional eager resolutions18→25. The complete earlier
 15 types, three replay/fact types, separate Preflight, both initializer callers
  and nonempty Normalizer warmup remain. Effective type closure27→34 is
  reflected in the amendment, README, manifest and new D179 entry.
- Installed Mago schema/configuration still require class cyclomatic15,
  Kan1.6, methods10, ordinary parameters5 and strict baseline. The existing
  constructor configuration is unchanged. The amended matrix is expressly
  excluded from qualification by the proposal's manual estimates. No eighth
  helper, suppression, baseline/threshold change or larger method/caller budget
  follows from a future failure.
- No SQL, current trust, F2, seed/provider/Clock or authority acquisition is
  introduced into these pure helpers or under a floor. Local group admission
  cannot authenticate a transcript, manufacture a native origin, grant a phase
  or complete publication recovery. Wire tags, schema keys, caps, actual-owner
  joins and all original native/release gates remain.

## P3-01 — nonblocking reference correction before adoption

At amendment §4:159, the sentence `each local relation in §3` points to the
inventory section. The relation definitions are in §1. Root confirmed this is
a replacement omission and will change only that occurrence to
`each local relation in §1` after this review, record the literal delta/final
hash, and refresh its candidate/manifest binding.

The actual relation definitions, required discriminators and scopes are
unambiguous; this is not an unresolved semantic choice. Under spec109's
affected-review rule Root may close this one P3 text correction by diff review
without restarting the unchanged semantic review or running Product gates.
The Green above is against the pinned candidate bytes; the exact editorial
successor must still be identified in Root's adoption record.

## Commands, results and changed files

Only E15/history-admission-contract-review-r2.md and its -inputs.json were written.
The companion stores literal commands, actual tool-reported durations/exits,
selected input before/after hashes, the Root mechanical receipt identity and
the contextual Task/STATE observations. Initial selected102 files were pinned;
the Root mechanical receipt was subsequently pinned before use as the103rd
selected input. All nine candidate hashes and all41 earlier semantic hashes
matched before review. Final stability and contextual changes are recorded in
the companion; contextual Root Task/STATE edits do not invalidate this finite
candidate review.

Commands were cat/sed/rg/nl and standard-library Python JSON/hash/unified-diff
bookkeeping. Truncated exploratory output was narrowed before relying on the
affected content. Their results are document inspections and management checks.
The review reused successful matching evidence and executed zero Product tests,
zero full suites and zero runtime/native/SQL gates. No PHP/Mago/Node/Docker/DB,
network or Git command ran. Test time is0; review/read/bookkeeping time is
separately recorded, not represented as Product execution.

## Acceptance boundary, remaining issues and Next Action

HAD-01/02/03 are resolved for this finite contract candidate. No additional
semantic Finding, source/namespace/method/caller exception or quality waiver is
requested. P3-01 remains the single Root editorial action.

Release Documentation Impact: this review changes only management evidence.
The internal proposed admission contract does not change current Stable1.2.1,
unreleased1.3, a public route/API/command/configuration, wire artifact or reader
source. Source/Search/LLM artifacts were not rebuilt; all full-child and
parent005/006 documentation/Owner-preview/same-SHA delivery requirements remain.

残り工程: Root's P3 correction, exact adoption and management commit; separately
issued bounded Luna carrier/helper/test/union work and its architecture owner;
HL-01/04 source closure; meaningful frozen-input tests and strict quality;
remaining Reader/Writer/preload/cold/native/SQL/full/export implementation and
qualification; full F5P/F4/F5/F6/D/E/G/004A/005/006 release/delivery and primary
integration obligations. Source success, Product Acceptance, same-SHA CI/export,
publication and deploy remain unverified here.

Next Action: Root makes the exact P3-01 correction, records the final hashes,
adopts/commits the coherent management unit, then issues only the next literal
worker scope with a separate exact runtime lease when ready. Root retains all
Task/Report/STATE, Git, adoption and Acceptance ownership.
